# Malt

> JSON-driven Homebrew Dev Services

Malt is a development environment manager for macOS that creates project-specific environments using only Homebrew. Define your stack in one JSON file (`malt.json`) and let your team replicate it anywhere with the portable `malt/` directory.

## Quick Start

```bash
brew tap shivammathur/php
brew tap shivammathur/extensions
brew tap koriym/malt
brew install malt

cd your-project
malt init      # Create malt.json
malt install   # Install Homebrew packages
malt create    # Generate malt/ config directory
malt start     # Start services
source <(malt env)  # Set up shell environment
```

## malt.json

Single source of truth for the project environment:

```json
{
  "project_name": "myapp",
  "dependencies": ["php@8.4", "mysql@8.0", "redis", "nginx", "composer"],
  "ports": {
    "php": [9000],
    "mysql": [3306],
    "nginx": [80],
    "redis": [6379]
  },
  "php_extensions": ["xdebug", "redis", "apcu"]
}
```

## Commands

- `malt init` - Create malt.json from template
- `malt install` - Install dependencies from malt.json
- `malt create` - Generate malt/ directory with service configs
- `malt start` - Start all configured services
- `malt stop` - Stop all services
- `malt status` - Show running status
- `malt kill` - Force-kill all services
- `malt env` - Output shell environment setup
- `malt info` - Show project information

## Supported Services

- PHP-FPM (multiple versions, custom extensions)
- Nginx (multiple virtual hosts)
- Apache HTTPD (multiple ports)
- MySQL (multiple instances)
- Redis
- Memcached

## Directory Structure

```
your-project/
├── malt.json          # Environment definition
├── malt/
│   ├── conf/          # Service config files
│   ├── logs/          # Service logs
│   ├── tmp/           # Temporary files
│   └── var/           # Data files (MySQL, etc.)
└── public/            # Document root
```

## Key Concepts

- Port-based isolation: Multiple projects coexist via different ports
- Template variables: Config files use `{{MALT_DIR}}`, `{{HOMEBREW_PREFIX}}`, `{{PORT}}`, etc., expanded at service start time
- Native performance: No VMs or containers; direct filesystem access
- Customization: Edit generated files in `malt/conf/` after `malt create`
